briefings.title: Can AI help us better predict the weather?

people.name: Peter Battaglia
people.role: Senior Director of Research, Google DeepMind

briefings.tldr: AI models developed by Google DeepMind—such as GraphCast, GenCast, and WeatherNext 3—are revolutionizing global weather forecasting by bypassing traditional supercomputer fluid dynamics approximations in favor of learning statistical patterns directly from decades of historical meteorological data, achieving significant performance gains including early warnings for extreme events like Category 5 storms.
